title: Local fixed-realization transport on the model sieve
statement: On a supplied finite-level comparison and model sieve, the fixed-realization images of the normalized constant model and the supplied étale complex are isomorphic on every member of a refined model sieve.

source.place: Tags 099Y, 099Z, 09B1 and 09BV; transport of a local model marking through the fixed realization.

proof.text: Keep the supplied covering sieve T. On a member w:W→U, specialize the existing localized constant-model family to g=W.hom followed by g, a=w.left and b=id_W. The derived identity inverse-image comparison removes b. This identifies the fixed realization of the localized normalized constant E with constantAdicQuotientRealization(W.hom followed by g,d,n)(E).

Set a=w.left and b=U.hom followed by g. Localize the proved ordinary fixed-realization inverse-image square, using lisseTowerFixedRealizationIso to identify its derived functors. Apply its component at comparisonUpperStar(D), then map the supplied comparison through the module inverse image along a. The canonical derived module inverse-image compositor identifies the result with the pullback of N along a followed by b. Its coefficient identification is the identity: the chosen coefficient along a is the inverse ring compositor, and the two ring compositors cancel.

The equation w.w, composed with g, gives a followed by b = W.hom followed by g. Rewrite the actual-object comparison by this equality. Compose the constant-model comparison, the marking supplied by T, and the inverse actual-object comparison. This gives the required isomorphism on every member of T; its original covering proof is unchanged. No refinement, geometric point, nonempty scheme or boundedness argument is needed.
